title: Require Runtime Domain Router Imports
forbids: recipe compilation importing domain contract roots instead of executable routers
why: Compiled recipes compose executable domain routers; declaration contracts are reserved for domain and step authoring boundaries.
remediate: Import the executable domain router from the domain's router.js surface in recipe runtime roots, and import the domain contract only from declaration or step-authoring code.
message: Recipe runtime files must import the domain's executable router surface.
